Through the slats of interior venetian blinds across the office partition, two adult patient relatives sit waiting in the corridor with a bag. Her expression is tired, guarded, complicit, not kind or triumphant. Tight cold institutional atmosphere, slightly elevated wide composition showing protagonist, open cabinet and waiting relatives. No celebratory or redemption light. No security monitor UI.

Scene: an ordinary early evening on an urban Chinese public bus. The adult protagonist wears a plain muted teal blouse, sitting by a wide window, her practical dark work bag resting on her lap.
